data_policy.theme_context: july_2026_theme_timeline.csv + daily_theme_priority.csv + daily_core_roles.csv; rows usable only from valid_from
data_policy.same_day_new_theme: not tradable in v1.1 even if an isolated intraday article exists, because intraday source coverage is not yet exhaustive; all web close-review context becomes usable next trading day only

core_confirmation.same_theme_confirmation: at least 2 named representatives excluding the candidate show return >=0 at observation OR one other representative is >=90% of its daily up-limit and a named capacity_core in the same theme is positive
core_confirmation.market_confirmation: whole-market median return at observation >= -1.5%, except ice_point_repair
core_confirmation.breadth_worsening_definition: for leader_weak_to_strong, whole-market advancer ratio at observation must be >= the 09:35 advancer ratio

prerequisites: candidate is not a prior negative_anchor
leader_divergence_to_consensus.trigger: open gap in [-4%,+5%]; at completed observation candidate close >= previous close OR close > day open; intraday range position >=60%; same-theme confirmation passes; candidate return <8.5%
forbidden: prior-day theme leader failed with batch negative anchors

leader_weak_to_strong.trigger: open gap in [-3.5%,+2%]; observation return >=1%; close > day open; intraday range position >=70%; same-theme confirmation passes; market advancer ratio at observation >=09:35 ratio

prerequisites: at least one theme in same valid_from is retreat OR prior market phase contains 主跌/退潮/分歧/冰点
new theme documented by prior close
new theme has at least two named representatives
low_level_switch.trigger: candidate return >0 and close > day open; at least two same-theme named representatives return >0; median return of prior negative anchors <=0; candidate return <8.5%
forbidden: theme identified only by same-day post-close hindsight
old negative anchors collectively reverse positive before entry

prerequisites: a named theme_leader exists and is tradable/observable
supplement_after_leader_confirmed.trigger: theme_leader return >0 and above day open; candidate return >0 and range position >=70%; at least two named representatives are non-negative
forbidden: candidate is itself a negative anchor

prerequisites: prior market phase contains 冰点 or 主跌 or 恐慌
ice_point_repair.trigger: whole-market advancer ratio improves >=10 percentage points from 09:35; candidate return >=1%; at least two same-theme named representatives return >0; whole-market advancer ratio >=30%

cash.trigger: no non-cash playbook passes all phase/theme/core/intraday gates

execution.month_end: liquidate at 2026-07-31 close for measurement only and mark evaluation liquidation

exit.hard_failure: first sellable day after entry: at 10:00 completed observation, if return from entry <= -5%, exit 10:01 open if sellable
exit.expectation_failure: first sellable day or later: at 10:00, if return vs prior close <= -2.5%, close below day open, and same-theme confirmation fails, exit 10:01 open
exit.leader_loss_of_status: if prior close review marks held stock negative_anchor OR its theme retreat, exit at next available 09:31 open if sellable
exit.right_tail: after post-entry MFE >=10%, exit at 10:01 open if 10:00 close is >=5% below post-entry peak or prior review removes core status
exit.time_stop: after 3 sellable days, if return from entry <3% and latest prior review does not retain the stock as an eligible core, exit at 10:01 open
exit.max_holding: after 7 sellable days exit at 10:01 unless latest prior review still retains the stock as an eligible core

learning.temporary_risk_response: 2 consecutive process-valid losses in same playbook => next two eligible entries in that playbook at 50% size; 3 consecutive process-valid losses => pause new entries in that playbook for next two trading days
